Available Health Tech at Walmart
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Over-the-counter biowearables like the Abbott Lingo track real-time glucose data without a prescription.

Blood Glucose Meters:
Traditional finger-prick kits (such as OneTouch and Contour) are widely stocked.
Smartwatches & Fitness Trackers:
Budget-friendly activity trackers and basic smartwatches are available, though non-medical smartwatches claiming non-invasive blood glucose or EKG readings lack clinical medical validation.
